prompts.text:
Use the attached APPROVED gameplay concept as the strict visual master for "我是大魔王". Produce ONE portrait 9:16 proposed gameplay screen, no device frame, no montage. It must look like a different state of the VERY SAME 2D pixel-art game: same camera north-up with slightly visible building front faces, same cute lime-green goblins, same chunky pixel grid, same scale, same warm yellow dirt path, sparse flat green grass, teal forest shapes, muted purple roof/flags, dark stepped outlines, terracotta melee tent, green bow tent. Preserve coarse low logical resolution approximately 216x384 displayed with nearest-neighbor crisp square pixels, no smooth curves/anti-aliasing, no painterly detail, no speckle noise, no dithering, no high-resolution decorative texture. Only two or three tone bands per object. Maintain the original reusable building silhouettes and restrained UI exactly. Never make characters or buildings more detailed than the approved reference. Header stays dark forest green with coin left, wave center, pause right, thin castle-health bar below. This is a design reference, not a claim of a real existing game.
SCENE: northern frontline during the first boss attack, coin counter 460, center title "第10波". Camera has followed the player slightly NORTH, so castle and production area are now OFF-SCREEN BELOW, which is intentional; do not squeeze the whole map into one screen. Top third: about 6 tiny cute human royal soldiers wearing blue tabards and silver helmets advancing DOWN the yellow road from the north, one larger cartoon knight commander with a blue cape, square shield and red crest behind them. They look toy-like, not grim. Add a narrow readable red boss bar under the castle bar, text "骑士长".
At 43% screen height, preserve the two wooden goblin watchtowers and short palisade from the master, with a visible central passage. Tower archers fire only two tiny pixel arrows northward. Small green health bars show one wall section partly damaged, no gore. The crowned purple-caped cute goblin king from the master is just in front of the passage, facing the invaders with 4 allied green melee goblins. At most two tiny white-yellow pixel hit sparks and one short white pixel slash indicate combat; no huge magical or cinematic effects. At lower 65% height the original terracotta and green troop tents flank the path, two tiny goblins are walking from tents toward the frontline. Small pixel status over melee tent "补员 4s". Generous empty ground separates squads, absolutely no noisy crowd. Same faint joystick bottom-left; crown button bottom-right. During battle omit the big '迎敌' button, leave a compact muted label "防守中" instead. Keep a cheerful clean playable readable pixel-art composition with battle concentrated in upper half.

Edit this pixel-art GAMEPLAY UI concept. Preserve the exact scene, cute goblins, buildings, forest, colors, pixel size, camera and top HUD. ONLY redesign the upgrade popup to follow the new strict UI rules: minimum text, key numbers and recognizable icons prominent, and absolutely NO middle-dot separator character anywhere (Unicode U+00B7 is forbidden).
Make the panel more compact, about 78% screen width and 48% screen height centered, so more of the dimmed base settlement is visible. Keep crisp coarse pixel-art borders, dark-green flat surfaces, clean simple lines, no painterly textures, no tiny decoration.
Header: a small terracotta melee-tent icon, the short title "近战营", a small close X. Under it a clear "1 → 2" and a gold coin icon followed by "80", no 'Lv.' and no word '金币'.
A small baseline row has the short label "基础", then three distinct spaced icon-number groups: goblin head '+1', sword '+10%', heart '+10%'. Separate groups using SPACE only, never dots or bullets.
Below, EXACTLY THREE vertically stacked large easy-to-touch option rows, equal styling. Each row contains one prominent pixel icon, one SHORT two-character label and one large number:
1. grouped goblin heads, label "增兵", number "+1";
2. wooden sword, label "攻击", number "+25%";
3. red pixel heart, label "生命", number "+30%".
A very small centered caption "三选一" can appear above these three options. No other descriptions. Remove all previous long texts: remove '近战营升级', '基础：士兵+1', '属性提升', '扩充编制', '额外增加1名士兵', '强化武器', '全队攻击', '坚韧训练', '全队生命', '选择一项强化'. No footer, extra confirmation button, advertisements, premium currencies or reroll button. No selected yellow card unless pressed; all three cards start neutral.
Use exact short Chinese text only as specified. A practical single-hand mobile game UI design, calm and readable, visually consistent with the accepted chunky pixel-art world. Output one portrait screen only.
